long_biography.plain_text:
Jaime Botín helped introduce direct motor insurance to Spain through Línea Directa, working with Peter Wood, the creator of Britain’s Direct Line. Founded in 1995 as a partnership between Bankinter and Royal Bank of Scotland, the insurer sold policies by telephone and subsequently online. Botín chaired the company during its first decade and championed its use of technology.

Portraiture was a particular interest in his art collecting. In 2018 he lent eight paintings to the Botín Foundation for display at Centro Botín in Santander, including works by Matisse, Bacon, Gris and Sorolla. He accompanied the loan with a commitment to annual funding for conservation, the centre’s artistic programme and its social mission.
